subject.title: feat(ui): redesign /btw side chat into a floating multi-turn panel

question: After the Escape defect is repaired and the lifecycle is proven, should the floating multi-turn side-chat panel replace the current inline `/btw` result in the Control UI?
rationale: This PR introduces a persistent conversational interaction and new close/clear semantics, so implementation correctness does not by itself confirm the intended long-term Control UI behavior.

options.title: Adopt after repair
options.body: Land the floating multi-turn panel after Escape handling, focused coverage, and real final-head lifecycle proof are complete.

options.title: Keep the inline result
options.body: Retain the existing single-result UI and close this redesign if persistent side-chat state is not desired.

options.title: Narrow the redesign
options.body: Use the floating panel but defer multi-turn follow-ups or persistent close state to a later product decision.

recommendation.title: Adopt after repair
recommendation.body: Land the floating multi-turn panel after Escape handling, focused coverage, and real final-head lifecycle proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current `/btw` Control UI behavior and adjacent selection interaction and is the strongest history-backed owner for this UX direction.
